title: Rules the director may never change by itself. Only the Creator changes them and seals them again.
creator: roppik

changes.what: max_parameters 60000000 -> 100000000 (the Creator's decision, so that a 88M core can become champion)
rules for domain packages added (the Creator's decision 2026-10-14): field exam +1.0 % at least, general text -2.0 % at most with the package on, base unchanged

abilities (the Creator's decision 2026-10-15: NOVA must not be content when it gets worse): the judge also compares the fixed abilities suite item by item (McNemar, Holm); no ability may get significantly worse on either path; a champion may be accepted for at least one significantly better ability if text is at most 1.0 % worse (vault 1.0 %), and the drift from the last text champion is bounded by the same 1.0 % in total

packages.note: a domain package learns one field on top of the frozen champion; it is accepted when the field's own exam improves and general text with the package switched on does not lose more than the limit; the base core never changes

abilities.note: abilities = evo/engine/abilities.py suite (skills new+form, RuleLab parts); text_tolerance applies to every decision set and to the total drift from the last champion accepted on text
